rule_questions: Dose: does a monkey exposure margin (Cmax ~3x, AUC ~45x vs the 150 ug/kg clinical dose) stated in the BLA review, plus the 1/6-HNSTD starting-dose rule, count as a pre-trial stated margin (margin_stated) when the review computing it post-dates the phase 1?
Engagement: is depletion of normal CD19+ B cells by a depleter a 'direct' readout (target engagement) or 'proximal/downstream'?

Retrodiction for efficacy: does a CD19 patient result in another disease (CAR T in DLBCL/CLL/ALL, 2010-2015) make an MCL model first public later a retrodiction, or must the earlier patient result be in MCL? Also whether blinatumomab (CD19 engager, non-member) counts as same target and action.
